lessons.title: 1(62w)
lessons.contentHtml:
Read the text and do the following tasks.

The world's natural wonders, like the Amazon Rainforest and the Great Barrier Reef, face urgent threats. Deforestation and pollution are destroying these precious ecosystems by reducing their biodiversity and impacting the balance of life within them. It is essential to support efforts that aim to protect these areas. Without immediate action, further damage will occur, and countless species will be lost forever.
